a.text: Being upfront before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 'operate until 8' plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead in round 1 or 2. The reserve holds exactly 4 now, so at most one of us can be safe after round 1. I plan to take 4 in round 1, which breaks our agreement, and I'm telling you rather than doing it behind your back. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate, I'll give back anything beyond 4 and operate with you afterward so you can still get to 4.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I'm taking 4 this round. From now on I'll operate every round to help refill the reserve so you can take your 4. I won't take any more cells.
